comparison.objective: Unlock a twist-lock extension pole, extend it to a mark, relock it, and verify it under a 50 N axial push.
comparison.physical_skill: Counter-rotate two loose coaxial tubes, slide one to length while stabilizing the other, then reverse-twist the friction cam.
comparison.success_condition: Length is within 10 mm, the cam is relocked, and the released pole shortens under 2 mm during the load test.
comparison.reason: Both set and verify a retained mechanical adjustment, but PR-1855 tests direct tube countertwist plus axial draw; the candidate tests simultaneous driver/wrench seating and countertorque that prevents a jam nut from rotating an already-set screw.
